$comment: ECC-5 Realness Profile — the fine-tuning surface for how human she feels. Every value here is a dial an operator can turn from the Persona Lab without touching code. Frontend motion and viseme layers read this live.
name: Phase One · Baseline Human

breath.$comment: Diaphragm. rateHz 0.20-0.28 is resting adult. amplitudeModHz creates the irregularity that stops it reading as a metronome — the single biggest tell of a fake idle.

sway.$comment: Slow postural drift on offset phases so no two axes share a period. Humans never hold still and never oscillate cleanly.

attention.$comment: Micro attention shifts — the saccade analogue. NVIDIA Maxine Audio2Face-2D calls this 'lookaway' and ships lookaway_interval_min 90f + range 240f, i.e. 3.0-11.0s at 30fps. Our window sits inside theirs, independently derived and then confirmed against their defaults.

blink.$comment: IMPLEMENTED as a masked eyelid sweep pinned to her eye positions — not a renderer output, but a real gesture: fast close, slower release, randomized interval, occasional double-blink. Values mirror NVIDIA Maxine A2F-2D blink_frequency (0-120bpm) and blink_duration (2-150 frames) so the handoff to the real renderer is a wiring job, not a redesign.
blink.method: masked eyelid sweep (CSS layer) — upgrade path is A2F-2D blink_frequency

depth.$comment: Parallax layering. A flat portrait moved as one rectangle is the Ken Burns effect, not a person — the frame reads as a photograph being panned. The backdrop counter-moves and blurs to become depth of field; the hair carries its own mass and arrives late behind the skull.

a2f2d.$comment: NVIDIA Maxine Audio2Face-2D ('Speech Live Portrait') payload, pre-tuned. Sent verbatim the moment the NIM is reachable on cloud GPU — hosted endpoints returned 404 on 2026-08-09, so this is container-only for now. Names and ranges are NVIDIA's, not ours.

speech.$comment: Talk pulse. jawGain maps ARKit jawOpen onto portrait displacement. coarticulationMs is the crossfade between adjacent visemes — 0 makes the mouth snap between shapes, which is the classic puppet tell. 45-70ms matches human articulator travel.

thresholds.$comment: ECC-5 scoring gates. Composite below backToLab sends her back for re-engineering — no shipping on vibes.
